name: Webflow
tagline: Visual web design platform with CMS, hosting, and ecommerce
verdictSummary: You can build a static site generator with a CMS backend (Next.js + a headless CMS) that covers the output side. But Webflow's visual editor — a WYSIWYG that outputs production-ready HTML/CSS — is a genuinely hard engineering problem. The visual CMS, interactions builder, and hosting CDN are each full products. You get the output, not the editor.
coreLoopDIY: Next.js site with headless CMS for content editing, deployed to Vercel
whatYouLose: Webflow CMS with collection lists and dynamic pages
Built-in SEO and Open Graph controls
Webflow hosting CDN with global edge caching
moatNotes: 💅 execution polish · 🏗️ infrastructure scale · 🎟️ content & rights
whyPeopleStillPay: Professional designers who want pixel-perfect control without writing code, plus managed hosting and CMS
